blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu City Council approved a resolution offering up to P1 million in reimbursement for a Rotary district conference. However, councilors questioned the justification for the financial aid amid a lack of clear rules governing municipal assistance to non-governmental organizations. The Council’s discussion on the reimbursement exposed the city’s reliance on the Office of the Mayor to determine assistance from the City Sponsored Activities fund, with no definitive guidelines currently setting eligibility criteria or subsidy limits, according to Councilor Philip Zafra.
